summary: Flat northern end of a residential street, homes 14-20 m all round.

best_section.where: west kerb near the northern end of Bywong Street, past the steep drop

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14-20 m away on both sides; no bush or park backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street wide enough for parked cars; kerbside room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked along the street; one No Stopping sign near the south end only.

flags: Steep south of 85 m: up to 27%
sun_shade: Open at this section; trees shade the east side to the north.
